officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records, District Collectorate Nagapattinam, identified on the official district service page; the district Survey and Settlement page describes the District Survey Unit and record custody.
officialSourceAssessment.stateService: Tamil Nadu Government land-record e-services at http://eservices.tn.gov.in/eservicesnew/home.html, linked by the official district administration page.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: The official district pages document local Survey and Land Records administration, digitized FMB work, Town Survey records, village maps, and land-record extracts. This is local registry/cadastre custody evidence, not open parcel-vector access.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official district page retrieved. It lists Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, Patta verification, and Poramboke verification services and links the Tamil Nadu e-services portal.
Official Tamil-language district service page was identified during native-language discovery; no parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the page content.

Official district Survey and Settlement page retrieved. It describes preparation of FMBs, village/taluk/district/town maps, digitization of FMBs, district survey custody, and Town Survey records held by municipal offices.

Bounded anonymous GET from the current environment timed out after 30 seconds. No login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, credentials, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was attempted. This is not evidence of service absence or a parcel hit/miss.

Official Tamil Nadu GIS landing page was retrieved through first-party discovery. It exposes a public GIS application directory and states that TNGIS data is informational and subject to use restrictions, but no anonymous Nagapattinam parcel layer or public parcel schema was identified.
Official district portal confirms Nagapattinam district administration and its online land-service lead; it does not publish a parcel-vector API.
